name: Codex vault custodian
design: Barrel-chested mature male with broad layered bronze biomask, high flattened center crest and two dark eye insets, thick long scalp tendrils arranged in low fan. Wide moss-green paneled apron over modest slate tunic and brown leggings, sturdy silver shoulder guards and bracers, short fringed sage cape. Left forearm supports a thick CLOSED reinforced codex against waist, right hand holds a small loop of oversized distinct archive keys; angular map cases at hips and clean cloth packet secured to belt.
